name: Ambient Sounds
description: Mix rain, thunder, waves, wind, fire, birds, a stream and brown noise to sleep, focus or relax, with a sleep timer.
prompt: An ambient sound mixer with eight sounds made in the browser (rain, thunder, waves, wind, fire, birds, stream, brown noise), a volume slider each, presets for sleep, focus, beach, camping and storm, and a timer that fades out.
author: gonzaroman
